text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've just wrapped up training for the day with Kitasan Black when she pauses and turns to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Would it be all right if I continue training a little by myself after this?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I don't know how to explain it, but… I don't feel like I've done enough running today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's gaze is focused on Satono Diamond, who is still running silently around the track even now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose to Dia. I just can't!
choice_data_list: I understand! I'll stay behind with you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Just like how sharing the weight of a portable shrine with everyone at a festival makes me feel more powerful…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just know I'll be able to do great so long as I'm with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After wrapping up our conversation, Kitasan Black and I do some extra intense training together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I know it's important to do things in moderation, but still…
choice_data_list: Instead of running, could I ask you a favor?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Can you tell me what you think of this new training routine I'm drafting?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'd be glad to if it'll help improve my running!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm. This combination of exercises can definitely help strengthen my weaknesses…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, could we increase the amount of weight lifting I do in this section? Considering how I did in my previous scrimmage…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I have a meeting with Kitasan Black and iron out a more efficient training routine for her.
